title: FIPS operational: fips_provider_count underflow on double-unregister
description: atomic_dec(&fips_provider_count) in crypto2dev_unregister_provider() (src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c:116) is called unconditionally when p->is_fips. If a provider module calls unregister_provider twice (module_exit bug or double-free), count goes negative. crypto2dev_fips_provider_loaded() reads the counter and returns false when count <= 0, silently disabling FIPS enforcement for all subsequent lookups. No guard or detection. Fix: use atomic_dec_if_positive or BUG_ON(atomic_read(&fips_provider_count) == 0) before decrement.
